# Summary

In this markdown we will perform the following processing steps:

1. Filter out doublets 
1. Visualize data to check results of filters
1. Save finalized seurat object for later use

Must have run part1 first

```{r load_libraries, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(wrh.rUtils)
library(wrh.scRNA)
library(bluster)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggpubr)
library(scDblFinder)
library(ggpubr)
library(data.table)
library(glmGamPoi)
options(future.globals.maxSize= 891289600000)

### Local run
# baseDir_v <- "/Volumes/wrh_padlock3/projects/AP/novogene/"
# dataDir_v <- file.path(baseDir_v, "align")
# rdsDir_v <- mkdir(baseDir_v, "rds")
# qcDir_v <- mkdir(baseDir_v, "qc")

### Exa run
baseDir_v <- "/home/exacloud/gscratch/CoussensLab/transcriptomic/novogene"
dataDir_v <- file.path(baseDir_v, "aligned")
rdsDir_v <- mkdir(baseDir_v, "rds")
qcDir_v <- mkdir(baseDir_v, "QC")
refDir_v <- file.path(baseDir_v, "ref")
plotDir_v <- mkdir(baseDir_v, "plots/noSketch")

seuratFile_v <- file.path(rdsDir_v, "qcAndDoubletFilter_lsobj.rds")

# Run Flags
minPC_v <- F
pcName_v <- ifelse(minPC_v, "minPC", "maxPC")
```

# Load

Load samples (1.5 min)

```{r, eval = T}
tictoc::tic()
seurat_lsobj <- readRDS(seuratFile_v)
tictoc::toc()
```

# Split Tissue

```{r, eval = T}
tictoc::tic()
tumor_lsobj <- seurat_lsobj[grep("^T", names(seurat_lsobj), value = T)]
blood_lsobj <- seurat_lsobj[grep("^B", names(seurat_lsobj), value = T)]
tictoc::toc()
```

# Merge Tissue - 3 min

```{r, eval = T}
tictoc::tic()
tumor_obj <- merge(x = tumor_lsobj[[1]], y = tumor_lsobj[-1])
blood_obj <- merge(x = blood_lsobj[[1]], y = blood_lsobj[-1])
tictoc::toc()
```

# Join Layers - 3 min

```{r, eval = T}
tictoc::tic()
tumor_obj <- JoinLayers(tumor_obj, assay = "RNA")
blood_obj <- JoinLayers(blood_obj, assay = "RNA")
tictoc::toc()
```

# Normalize 

```{r, eval = T}
tictoc::tic()
tumor_obj <- NormalizeData(tumor_obj) 
tumor_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(tumor_obj)
tumor_obj <- ScaleData(tumor_obj)
tumor_obj <- RunPCA(tumor_obj)
tumorPcs_v <- findPCs(tumor_obj, ndims_v = 50, min_v = minPC_v)
tictoc::toc()

tictoc::tic()
blood_obj <- NormalizeData(blood_obj)
blood_obj <- FindVariableFeatures(blood_obj)
blood_obj <- ScaleData(blood_obj)
blood_obj <- RunPCA(blood_obj)
bloodPcs_v <- findPCs(blood_obj, ndims_v = 50, min_v = minPC_v)

invisible(gc())
tictoc::toc()
```

# Cluster QC

```{r, eval = T}
# myClusterSweep(seurat_obj = tumor_obj, ndims_v = tumorPcs_v, name_v = "tumor",
#              indPlots_v = T, plotDir_v = mkdir(qcDir_v, "noSketch_clusterQC"))
# invisible(gc())
tumorRes_v <- 0.8

# myClusterSweep(seurat_obj = blood_obj, ndims_v = bloodPcs_v, name_v = "blood",
#              indPlots_v = T, plotDir_v = mkdir(qcDir_v, "noSketch_clusterQC"))
# invisible(gc())
bloodRes_v <- 0.8
```

# Cluster

```{r, eval = T}
tictoc::tic()
tumor_obj <- FindNeighbors(tumor_obj, dims = 1:tumorPcs_v, verbose = F)
tumor_obj <- FindClusters(tumor_obj, resolution = tumorRes_v, verbose = F)
tumor_obj <- RunUMAP(tumor_obj, dims = 1:tumorPcs_v, verbose = F, return.model = T)
tictoc::toc()

tictoc::tic()
blood_obj <- FindNeighbors(blood_obj, dims = 1:bloodPcs_v, verbose = F)
blood_obj <- FindClusters(blood_obj, resolution = bloodRes_v, verbose = F)
blood_obj <- RunUMAP(blood_obj, dims = 1:bloodPcs_v, verbose = F, return.model = T)
tictoc::toc()

invisible(gc())
```

```{r}
  ggtitle("Tumor - By Treatment")

  ggtitle("Tumor - By Sample")
```


# DotPlot

## Tumor

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=16}
tumorNoSortDot_gg <- DotPlot(tumor_obj,
        features = unname(dotMarkers_v),
        cols = "RdYlBu") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = paste(names(dotMarkers_v), unname(dotMarkers_v), sep = "_")) +
  coord_flip() +
  ggtitle("Tumor - mPop Markers")

tumorNoSortDot_gg
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=16}
#Order populations after looking at dotplot
tumorPops_lsv <- list("bcell" = 22,
                      "tcell" = c(6, 7, 12, 21, 25, 30, 36, 1, 9, 18, 20, 23, 24, 26, 27, 29),
                      "otherT" = c(14),
                      "nk" = c(4, 8),
                      "mdsc" = c(2, 3, 39),
                      "caf" = c(32),
                      "endo" = 37,
                      "tumor" = 19,
                      "otherMyeloid" = c(0, 5, 10, 11, 13, 15, 16, 17, 28, 31, 33, 34, 35))
tumorPops_lsv$other <- setdiff(0:41, unlist(tumorPops_lsv, use.names = F))

tumor_obj$sortCluster <- factor(as.character(tumor_obj$seurat_clusters), levels = unlist(tumorPops_lsv, use.names = F))
```

```{r}
### Add to object
tumor_obj$firstPassPop <- character(length = length(tumor_obj$orig.ident))
for (pop_v in names(tumorPops_lsv)) {
  clust_v <- tumorPops_lsv[[pop_v]]
  tumor_obj@meta.data[tumor_obj$seurat_clusters %in% clust_v, "firstPassPop"] <- pop_v
}

tumorFirstPass_gg <- DimPlot(tumor_obj, group.by = "firstPassPop") + 
  ggtitle("Tumor - First Pass M Pop")

tumorFirstPass_gg

pdf(file = file.path(plotDir_v, "tumorFirstPassPops.pdf"))
tumorFirstPass_gg
dev.off()
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=16}
tumorSortDot_gg <- DotPlot(tumor_obj,
        features = unname(dotMarkers_v),
        group.by = "sortCluster",
        cols = "RdYlBu") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = paste(names(dotMarkers_v), unname(dotMarkers_v), sep = "_")) +
  coord_flip() +
  ggtitle("Tumor - mPop Markers")

tumorSortDot_gg
```

```{r}
pdf(file = file.path(plotDir_v, "tumorDot.pdf"), width = 14, height = 16)
tumorNoSortDot_gg
tumorSortDot_gg
dev.off()
```

# Subset

```{r}
### Tumor
tumorPopGroups_lsv <- list("lymphoid" = unlist(tumorPops_lsv[c("bcell", "tcell", "otherT", "nk")]),
                           "myeloid" = unlist(tumorPops_lsv[c("mdsc", "otherMyeloid")]),
                           "other" = unlist(tumorPops_lsv[c("caf", "endo", "tumor", "other")]))

subTumor_lsobj <- list()
for (i in 1:length(tumorPopGroups_lsv)) {
  
  currGrpName_v <- names(tumorPopGroups_lsv)[i]
  currGrpClusters_v <- tumorPopGroups_lsv[[currGrpName_v]]
  
  currCells_v <- rownames(tumor_obj@meta.data[tumor_obj$seurat_clusters %in% currGrpClusters_v,])
  currObj <- subset(tumor_obj, cells = currCells_v)
  subTumor_lsobj[[currGrpName_v]] <- currObj
}

### Blood
bloodPopGroups_lsv <- list("lymphoid" = unlist(bloodPops_lsv[c("bcell", "tcell", "tb", "nk", "otherLymphoid")]),
                           "myeloid" = unlist(bloodPops_lsv[c("mdsc", "mono", "otherMyeloid")]))

subblood_lsobj <- list()
for (i in 1:length(bloodPopGroups_lsv)) {
  
  currGrpName_v <- names(bloodPopGroups_lsv)[i]
  currGrpClusters_v <- bloodPopGroups_lsv[[currGrpName_v]]
  
  currCells_v <- rownames(blood_obj@meta.data[blood_obj$seurat_clusters %in% currGrpClusters_v,])
  currObj <- subset(blood_obj, cells = currCells_v)
  subblood_lsobj[[currGrpName_v]] <- currObj
}
```

# Write out objects

```{r}
tictoc::tic()
sapply(names(subTumor_lsobj), function(x) saveRDS(subTumor_lsobj[[x]], 
                                                  file = file.path(rdsDir_v, paste0("fromTumor_", x, ".rds"))))
tictoc::toc()

tictoc::tic()
sapply(names(subblood_lsobj), function(x) saveRDS(subblood_lsobj[[x]], 
                                                  file = file.path(rdsDir_v, paste0("fromBlood_", x, ".rds"))))
tictoc::toc()

tictoc::tic() # 25 min...
saveRDS(tumor_obj, file = file.path(rdsDir_v, "tumor_noSketchAndProcess.rds"))
saveRDS(blood_obj, file = file.path(rdsDir_v, "blood_noSketchAndProcess.rds"))
tictoc::toc()
```
